item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Trump Threatens to Hit Power Plants Unless Strait Is Reopened, as Tehran Remains Defiant
item.summary: President Trump issued an ultimatum after Iranian missiles struck cities in southern Israel, including one near the country’s main nuclear research center.

item.title: On Beirut’s Waterfront, Loss Meets Life, and Luxury, Amid War
item.summary: Thousands displaced by Israeli strikes on Lebanon’s capital now shelter along the promenade hugging the Mediterranean Sea. They share it with joggers, cyclists and dog walkers, alongside dizzying displays of wealth.

item.title: Terror Attacks Haunted This Brussels Community. Now It’s Trying to Move On.
item.summary: Molenbeek was branded a hotbed of radicalization after terrorists hit Brussels and Paris a decade ago, but new challenges show that reinvention doesn’t come easy.

item.title: With Fire and Song, Kurds in Turkey Hail the Start of Spring
item.summary: The Newroz holiday comes at a critical time, as Kurds in Turkey push for peace while their brethren in Syria and Iran fear further conflict.

item.title: Zelensky Sends Negotiators to the U.S., Hoping to Revive Peace Talks
item.summary: The Ukrainian president has said he has a “very bad feeling” about the effects of the Iran conflict on Ukraine’s own war.

item.title: Iranian Sailors, Including Survivors of Torpedoed Ship, Remain in Limbo
item.summary: Sri Lanka has kept more than 250 sailors in protective custody since the early days of the war. Iran wants them back, but Sri Lanka is unsure what to do with them.

item.title: Residents of Arad Are Shaken After Direct Strike by Iranian Missile
item.summary: Attacks on Saturday injured dozens in Arad and Dimona, two cities closest to Israel’s main nuclear research facility.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Saturday
item.summary: An Iranian missile wounded dozens in Dimona, a city believed to house Israel’s nuclear weapons program, as Iran showed no signs of backing down.

item.title: Iranian missile strikes Israeli city near main nuclear research facility.
Internet Blackout Keeps Iranians From Reaching Loved Ones During Nowruz Holiday
item.summary: The current restrictions on the internet in Iran are coinciding with Nowruz, the observance of the Persian New Year.
